name: Stormveil
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond ancient meteor crater the sky stays the color of a bruise.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
